title: task_plan — the box's plan for one ralph-v2 Task (docs/plans/ralph-v2 C2)
description: The ralph-v2 task_plan output. task_plan_gate re-checks it against the Task (every acceptance statement covered, every cited path:N real), stores it as task_plans/<id>.json and renders task-context.md from it. _io is stamped by the server.

context.description: The refreshed dossier: `## Files and symbols`, `## Plan`, `## Done when`. Every path:N is true in this checkout.

id.description: g1 to g4, in the order to work them.

goal.description: One outcome, in one or two sentences.

covers.description: 1-based indexes into the Task's acceptance list that this goal satisfies. Together the goals cover every index.

check.description: How to show the goal holds: a command in backticks, or the path:N of the test that proves it or that will hold it.

files.description: Repository-relative paths the goal is expected to touch; may name new files; may be empty.

edge_cases.description: 0 to 6 cases, each a test to write. Only cases an acceptance statement covers.

covers.description: The 1-based index of the acceptance statement that makes this case in scope.

bug_class.description: For a Task whose source is refute, review or local_review: the class of input or state the finding is one example of, and where else in this branch it applies. An empty string otherwise.

items.description: One sentence for the reviewer, such as a caller outside the diff.
